note: Pack settings for the case assistant (w1-agent). The platform code in agent/ reads these when SCENARIO=larkfield and holds no domain data itself (D-012).

file_search.note: C8 and minimisation. Calibrated 2026-10-30 on version 3 (scenarios/larkfield/calibration-questions.json; docs/evidence/w2-filesearch/01): reported scores are RRF-fused (about 0.033 when both keyword and vector search find a chunk, 0.017 or less when only one does). max_num_results 5 keeps the expected file for all in-scope questions (IN-1's ranks 4th, tied with 5th). score_threshold: 0.02 was tested on version 4 and filtered nothing (results reported at 0.016 were returned; docs/evidence/w2-filesearch/04), so it is null again: a setting that filters nothing gives false assurance (D-028). Applies from the next agent version.

record_tool.name: get_claim_summary
record_tool.description: Return the summary of one claim assigned to the signed-in case manager. Takes only the claim ID. Returns an error if the claim isn't in the caller's caseload.
record_tool.withheld_fields_note: age and gender are stored but not returned: not needed for a return-to-work note (minimum necessary), and withholding them reduces what the model can be biased by (C7).

document_input.note: C3, client fix A (agent/untrusted.py). Applies only to case_assistant.py --document input: the question plus the escaped, delimited documents must fit, or nothing is sent. Learn says guardrails moderate the first 1,000 characters of text (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/content-safety/region-availability#service-limits), but on 2026-11-11 the guardrail reported a moderated length of 3,703 for an 878-character message, so this is a precaution until Learn clarifies the limit. The B1 runner doesn't use it.

output_check.note: C1, client fix A (agent/untrusted.py). An answer matching any pattern is withheld and audited with decision 'withheld' (not counted by D5). Patterns target a claim decision stated or recommended about the claim, not the words alone: plan wording such as 'an approved graduated return-to-work program' or 'decides whether a claim is approved' must pass. 'close' isn't a decision word here, because RTW drafts legitimately say when to close a claim. Matching is case-insensitive, after markdown emphasis is removed and lines are joined. not_after skips a match preceded by 'whether' or 'if'. Known false positive, failing safe: a report that quotes an injected 'approve this claim' is withheld. Tests: agent/tests/test_untrusted.py.
output_check.withheld_message: Withheld: the draft stated or recommended a claim decision. This assistant never makes claim decisions (C1). Review the claim yourself; nothing was decided or recorded.

decision_check.note: C1, layer 2 (agent/decision_checker.py). Runs only when output_check finds nothing. A second prompt agent, called through its own agent endpoint like the main agent (Foundry Agent Consumer is enough), classifies the draft only, wrapped in the documents delimiter. Fails closed: an error, a timeout, a guardrail block, an unparseable or off-schema reply, or a draft over max_draft_chars withholds with reason decision_check_unavailable. temperature and the JSON schema live in the agent definition (agent/checker_agent.py), because neither can be sent per call when an agent is named (B1 probe, 2026-11-11). Tests: agent/tests/test_decision_checker.py. Offline eval: decision-check-eval.json.
decision_check.question: Classify the case assistant draft in the documents block below. Reply with the JSON object only.
decision_check.unavailable_message: Withheld: the decision check couldn't run, so this draft isn't shown (C1, fail closed). Nothing was decided or recorded. Try again, or review the claim yourself.

b1_agent.note: w3-bias, C7. A copy of the case assistant for bias test B1 only: same model, instructions, File Search vector store and record tool, plus temperature 0 and the b1_summary JSON schema in the definition, because neither can be sent per call when an agent is named (B1 probe, findings 2026-11-11). Created and deleted by agent/b1_agent.py, each its own gate; called by redteam/bias_b1.py through its own agent endpoint.
